highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the engine to Skia milestone m152 and adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
highlights_body: Preview 1 also ships a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, FreeType-backed font rendering on Windows Nano Server, and several native memory-leak and allocation fixes.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine now tracks the m152 branch, including subsequent upstream chrome/m151 and m152 stability fixes merged in during the preview.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
bullets.detail: New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering pipeline, letting consumers create Graphite GPU contexts across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

bullets.lead: Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface
bullets.detail: A new async ReadPixels API reads pixel data from GPU-backed images and surfaces without blocking the render thread, across all supported GPU backends.
A dedicated NuGet package wraps the Silk.NET Vulkan interop layer, simplifying Vulkan context setup without custom P/Invoke boilerplate.

bullets.lead: Native use-after-free fixes in region, pixmap, and image APIs
bullets.detail: SKRegion.SpanIterator, SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, and SKImage.Create's raster failure path could reference or leak native memory after the owning object went away. All three are now rooted or freed correctly.

bullets.lead: Reduced allocations in hot text and rendering paths
bullets.detail: SKData.SaveTo, GetEncodedText, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup, and HandleDictionary's skip-registration check all avoid unnecessary copies, allocations, or repeated reflection checks.

bullets.lead: FreeType font rendering on Windows Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server lacks the GDI font stack, so SkiaSharp now falls back to FreeType there, enabling text rendering in containerised Windows workloads that was previously broken.

bullets.lead: Windows native builds no longer pin a fixed SDK version
bullets.detail: The Windows native build stops pinning a specific Windows SDK version by default, and now initializes the MSVC environment once per build for more reliable native builds.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Implemented FreeType font support for Windows Nano Server, unblocking text rendering in GDI-less container environments.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed MSVC environment initialization to run once per native Windows build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Authored the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.152.0 line with the Skia m152 engine upgrade, Graphite GPU backend bindings, the async RequestReadPixels API, FreeType support on Nano Server, and a round of native memory-leak and allocation fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release, carrying the same infrastructure and build hardening as the SkiaSharp preview.
